headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Modern Security Features
summary: Integrate real-time security checks and threat intelligence feeds to improve the risk assessment of npm/PyPI packages. Implement a user-friendly interface for managing lockfiles and dependencies. Add support for Rust package verification to cover more programming languages.
actions: Incorporate threat intelligence APIs from services like VirusTotal or OWASP Dependency-Check to scan for known vulnerabilities before installation.
Develop a graphical user interface (GUI) that allows users to easily manage lockfiles, view dependency trees, and understand the risks associated with each pack
Extend support to Rust packages by adding checks against Cargo.lock files and integrating with Rust-specific security databases.
